# Neuromorphic_Spiking_Integration

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The incorporation of spiking neural network dynamics into in-network processing elements, allowing network infrastructure to perform neuromorphic computation. Brings event-driven, low-power computation directly into the network, reducing latency and energy for distributed intelligence.
